name: AI Intent Authority via EIP-7702 ERC-1271 Policy Module
rationale: Live signingAuthority already has EIP-7702 code (ef0100…) so Authorizer already uses ERC-1271 path
AI never receives Program Token Reserve, owner keys, or FeeSink custody — only authorizes intent digests
No AWS KMS required: agent signing key is a dedicated non-custodial policy key validated by 1271 module
No Treasury Runtime: fees remain Program → FeeSink → FeeReceiver
Founder retains recovery: clear/change 7702 delegation, pause/stop programs, revoke AI key in policy module

authoritySurface.accepts: AI agent signature (or session key) over the same EIP-712 intent digest Authorizer hashes
policyChecksSuggested: max grossQuoteTarget / rate bps ceilings tighter than on-chain if desired
kill switch / revoked agent key list
optional Founder co-sign for first N executions (bootstrap)

runtime.decisionEngine: observe eligible flow → EXECUTE|SKIP (existing library + production worker)
runtime.policyEngine: off-chain + on-chain 1271 policy; reject unsafe intents before sign
runtime.signer: AI agent key — signs digest only; never holds Program funds
runtime.relay: permissionless submitter of (intent, signature); gas wallet only

rejectedNearTerm.B: requires replacing immutable signingAuthority via new Authorizer+Factory
rejectedNearTerm.E: optional later generation; not needed to unlock AI on current canary Factory
rejectedNearTerm.D_as_default: use as optional hardening, not default if full autonomy required

implementationSequenceFutureMissions: Design/spec EIP-7702 ERC-1271 policy module interface (still no LB contract changes)
Wire production decision+policy worker against intent-builder
Provision AI agent signing key (non-KMS) + Founder revoke path
Canary: first signed execute on MARCO/WBNB Active program
explicitNonGoals: Do not give AI Program owner role
Do not move Token Reserve to agent wallet
Do not require AWS KMS for v1 AI authority
Do not redeploy Factory/Authorizer for first AI path
